title: Corollary 2 in Example and Instance (2025)
headline: The proof of Corollary 2 does not establish it: a step applies Lemma 4 uniformly, but the lemma is only pointwise. No counterexample was found, so the corollary itself remains open (proof incomplete).

work.title: Identification of Random Coefficients in Binary Choice with a Special Regressor

claims.label: Corollary 2
claims.statement: Under Assumptions 1–3, the distribution of the random coefficients is identified from the conditional choice probabilities.
conditions: special regressor conditionally independent of the coefficients
claims.quantifiers: for every coefficient distribution satisfying Assumptions 1–3

result.witness: The proof applies Lemma 4 uniformly over the support of the special regressor, but Lemma 4 is stated pointwise. A bounded example shows the uniform version of Lemma 4 fails under Assumptions 1–3.
result.repair_note: A uniform version of Lemma 4 under an added tail condition may complete the proof; we have not checked this.
not_claimed: Corollary 2 is not claimed to be false.
Theorem 1, the paper's main identification result, is not affected.
